title: Egg landing in a Brazilian town (Moment of Contact)

tellings.quote: Everybody in this little town in Brazil reports seeing an egg landing and it seems to be emitting this sort of like ammonia like thing and even seems to kill a doctor.

plain: In a small town in Brazil, everyone is said to have reported seeing an egg-shaped object land, give off something like ammonia, and apparently cause the death of a doctor. Michels sums this up from the documentary Moment of Contact, made by James Fox, and does not name the town or give a date. If true, it would be a mass sighting in which a landed craft actually hurt people.
